outline: The main purpose of this course is to study the vibration and dynamical behavior of structures by using simplified and idealized models. Seismic response spectra are also introduced.
schedule:
1st. Week Introductions－Degree of freedom, spring constant
2nd. Week Official Break
3rd. Week Undamped single degree of freedom systems－D’Alembert’s principle
4th. Week Undamped systems with excitation functions－Dynamic load factor
5th. Week Damped single degree of freedom systems－Coulomb’s dry damping, viscous damping
6th. Week Damped systems with excitation forces
7th. Week Support motion－Seismic instruments
8th. Week General dynamic loading－Forced vibration with damping
9th. Week Approximate design method
10th. Week Midterm exam.
11th. Week Multi-degree of freedom systems
12th. Week Shear buildings
13th. Week Free vibration systems－Orthogonal property
14th. Week Damped vibration of shear building
15th. Week Modal analysis
16th. Week Response spectra
17th. Week Final reports
18th. Week Make-up
